title: He speaks English very well. (word order 1)
subtitle: verb + object, place + time
summary: Keep the verb and the object together, and put the place before the time.

lesson.heading: verb + object
lesson.text: Sue sits in an armchair every day with a newspaper. We say: Sue (subject) **reads** (verb) **a newspaper** (object) every day. The verb and the object are usually together. Nothing goes between them.

examples.wrong: Sue reads every day a newspaper

lesson.heading: The object comes straight after the verb
rows: a lot of people to the party.
lesson.note: *very well*, *very much*, *slowly* and *often* never come between the verb and the object.

lesson.heading: Nothing between verb and object
lesson.text: Words like **very well**, **very much**, **quickly** and **carefully** come after the object, not before it.

examples.wrong: I like very much Italian food
Did you watch all evening television

examples.text: Why do you always make **the same mistake**?
I'm going to borrow **some money** from the bank.

lesson.heading: Place before time
lesson.text: We went **to a party** (where?) **last night** (when?). The place comes first and the time comes after it. Time words answer *when?*, *how long?* or *how often?*

examples.text: We went **to a party last night**.
examples.wrong: We went last night to a party
Lisa walks every day to work
I usually go early to bed

lesson.text: Ask two questions in this order: *where?* then *when?* - I had my breakfast **in bed this morning**.

exercises.statement: Sue reads a newspaper every day.
exercises.explanation: Correct. The verb reads and the object a newspaper are together.

exercises.statement: I like very much this picture.
exercises.explanation: I like this picture very much. very much comes after the object.
The object (the door) comes straight after the verb.

exercises.answer: I bought a new computer last week.

exercises.prompt: Match each place with the time that finishes the sentence.

pairs.left: They've lived in the same house
Joe's father has been in hospital

exercises.answer: Emily doesn't speak French very well.
exercises.explanation: very well comes after the object French.

options: I drink three cups of coffee every day.
I drink every day three cups of coffee.
I drink three cups every day of coffee.
exercises.explanation: The object (three cups of coffee) comes after the verb, and the time comes last.

exercises.statement: Tom started last week his new job.
exercises.explanation: Tom started his new job last week. The object goes before the time.
Place before time: in London in 1980.

exercises.answer: We met some friends at the airport.
exercises.explanation: verb + object (some friends), then the place.

exercises.answer: I saw a beautiful bird in the garden this morning.
exercises.explanation: object, then place (in the garden), then time (this morning).

exercises.answer: Are you going to the cinema tomorrow evening?
exercises.explanation: Place (to the cinema) before time (tomorrow evening).
